definition: Every input field resolves to an official source with a retrieval date, or the strategy is blocked.
test: Walk each field to its source_id; confirm the live page still contains the value.
pass_threshold: 100% of fields sourced; 0 blanks in required fields.
why_it_exists: A model fed by an unsourced field cannot be audited, and cannot be defended once it loses money.

definition: The hypothesised relationship is measurably present before any bet logic is written.
test: Pearson r with a bootstrap 95% CI on the ingested sample.
why_it_exists: Without a measurable effect you are fitting noise. ST06 is the worked example of a fail.

definition: The strategy beats the closing line on data it was not fitted on.
test: Walk-forward test: fit on seasons 1..n, test on n+1. Grade against closing prices.
pass_threshold: Positive ROI with a 95% CI lower bound > 0 over >= 3 held-out seasons.
why_it_exists: In-sample profit is the single most common way backtests lie.

definition: Even in a losing stretch, did the strategy systematically beat the close?
test: Mean CLV in cents of implied probability, per bet.
pass_threshold: Mean CLV > 0 with 95% CI excluding zero.
why_it_exists: CLV is a far lower-variance skill indicator than win rate; it separates skill from luck faster than ROI does.

definition: Reported edge is stated net of vig, not gross.
test: Recompute EV per bet using the actual price paid, per bet, not an average.
pass_threshold: Net EV > 0 at the price actually available.
why_it_exists: At -110 you need 52.38% just to break even; a 55% 'winner' at -150 is a loser.

definition: Split results into skill and variance components and show the skill component is positive.
test: Compare realised wins to a Luck-Expected Wins model; report the skill residual and its CI.
pass_threshold: Skill residual > 0 with 95% CI excluding zero, after controlling for opponent strength.
why_it_exists: One-score game records and turnover margins are dominated by variance.

definition: For multi-leg bets, the dependence between legs is estimated, not assumed to be zero.
test: Estimate rho from event-level data; reprice the bet with a copula; compare to the offered price.
pass_threshold: The repriced EV stays positive after the book's own correlation adjustment.
why_it_exists: Computed: rho=0.40 flips a two-leg parlay from -8.9% to +15.0% EV. Assuming independence is a 24-point error.

definition: The signal fires from a scheduled job with no human judgement per bet.
test: Re-run the pipeline from a clean checkout and reproduce the exact bet list.
pass_threshold: Byte-identical output on re-run; no manual overrides recorded.
why_it_exists: Manual override is undetectable hindsight, and it is exactly what the owner asked to avoid.

definition: The edge survives realistic stake sizes and actual available limits.
test: Compare required stake to typical limits; simulate slippage.
pass_threshold: Edge remains positive at the target stake, after slippage.
why_it_exists: A 3% edge on a $50 limit is not a business.

definition: The strategy's apparent edge survives a false-discovery correction across all tested strategies.
test: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR across the full registry, or a deflated Sharpe ratio.
pass_threshold: Survives FDR at q = 0.10 across the registry.
why_it_exists: Computed: across 500 zero-edge strategies, at least one showing >=55% by luck is effectively certain. Without this gate, the leaderboard rewards noise.
